CountdownEvent.title: CountdownEvent
CountdownEvent.description: Represents an event countdown timer with customizable alarms

title.description: The title of the countdown event

description.description: Optional notes or details for the countdown event

targetDate.description: Target date and time in ISO format

category.description: Category or tag for grouping events

color.description: Accent color identifier for the event card

alarmSound.description: Sound profile for the countdown alarm

alarmEnabled.description: Whether sound alarm triggers when reaching zero

isPinned.description: Whether the event is pinned to top hero section

createdByUid.description: UID of the allow-listed Google user who created the event

createdByEmail.description: Google email of the user who created the event

updatedAt.description: Last updated timestamp in ISO format

AllowlistUser.title: AllowlistUser
AllowlistUser.description: Allow-listed user allowed to create and manage countdown events

email.description: Google email address allowed to manage events

role.description: Role of the user: admin or creator

addedBy.description: Email or UID of who added this user

/events/{eventId}.description: Collection of countdown events created by allow-listed users

/allowlist/{userId}.description: Allow-listed users permitted to add and manage countdown events

/test/{docId}.description: Path used for verifying Firestore connectivity on boot
